# HINT

HINT is a local CLI for path-scoped research memory. Its fixed workflow is
Hypothesis → Iteration → Notice → Thesis. Knowledge is readable Markdown in a
`<file>.hint` companion or an inherited folder `_.hint`.

Install: `npm install --global @openhint/cli`

Start each agent session with `hint guide`. Before work, run `hint <path...>`
to read accepted Thesis guidance. Use `hint --help` for the complete command
surface and the repository documentation for the format and quality rules.

HINT validates records, links, states, revisions, and optional evidence
fingerprints. It does not execute checks from Markdown, call an LLM, or prove
that a claim is true.

Source: https://github.com/open-hint-dev/hint
Demo: https://github.com/open-hint-dev/hint-demo
